Subject: Intro + Discovery Recap — InnovateTech / Redwood trial interest

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the candidness on latency and compliance constraints. Quick recap from our call so we have alignment: 

- Primary goal: embed low-latency summarization into InnovateTech's customer support workflow (3-4k tokens typical context).
- Key constraints: SOC2 evidence, on-prem/private deployment option for PII data, <120ms median token latency target for 95th percentile.
- Success metric: 20% reduction in AHT and 5pt CSAT uplift in pilot.

Immediate next steps we agreed on:
1) I’ll put together a lean pilot proposal and SOW draft (attached).
2) You’ll confirm procurement timeline and whether procurement/prod-security want a shared evidence packet (SOC2 report + data handling doc).
3) Quick internal trial kickoff call with your infra lead — target week of Aug 23.

I attached a one-pager recap and an initial SOW draft for procurement to review. If the budget/approval path is still the same for Q3 close, we could aim to get a PO in this quarter; if not, we should discuss a phased pilot instead.

[Attachment: redwood-discovery-recap.pdf (PDF, 240KB)]
[Attachment: innovatech-sow-draft.docx (DOCX, 45KB)]

Would you be able to confirm the procurement owner and an expected window for sign-off? If it helps, I can put together a short checklist for your procurement team.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
